text:
Aisha: OK team, urgent: a pigeon on the 3rd-floor balcony just sneezed directly into the ficus. Do we have a sneeze protocol or should we draft a 'Sneeze Pigeon Ordinance'? :pigeon:
Tom: omg :joy: are pigeons now part of compliance?
Jun: This is why I bring a travel umbrella everywhere. Also, bless you, pigeon.
Maya: Proposal: pigeon wears tiny hat. Mandatory. :tophat:
Kerry: I second the hat. Also vote to install a tiny sign that says 'No Sneezing on Plants' — aesthetics + deterrent.
Leon: Can we get Facilities to move the ficus indoors? It’s on a trajectory with seagulls anyway.
Aisha: @Maya @Kerry love the hat. I'm half-serious about a sign. Also low-key wondering whether this needs to be a poll.
Tom: Poll it. Democracy first. /poll "Sneeze Pigeon Ordinance" "Tiny hat + sign" "Move ficus inside" "Do nothing, admire nature"
Ops Bot: New poll created: "Sneeze Pigeon Ordinance" — vote with :one: :two: :three: :four: (ends in 12h)
Jun: Voting :one: (for tiny hat, but also for the ficus to be ok)
Maya: :two: for the sign, but I will grudgingly accept a hat.
Kerry: :three: I will carry the ficus to my desk if needed.
Leon: :four: We should do nothing. This is premium lore.
Aisha: Results so far: :one: 1, :two: 1, :three: 1, :four: 1. Tie already. Classic Redwood.
Tom: Can we establish an honorary title: "Chief Pigeon Whisperer"? Nominate @Jun.
Jun: I accept. Conditions: hat must be washable.
Maya: Also, I demand an embroidered sash.
Kerry: Logistics: Facilities slack, can you weigh in? @Ops Bot, please escalate to facilities if poll ends with >50% hat+sign/move ficus options.
Ops Bot: Facilities ticket #FAC-721 opened: "Balcony pigeon incident — guidance requested". Assigned to Facilities Team.
Aisha: Assigning provisional duties: Jun = Chief Pigeon Whisperer, Maya = Sash Design Lead, Kerry = Ficus Relocation Advocate.
Tom: I will make a mockup of the tiny hat. Deliverables: 3 sizes, waterproof.
Leon: If a pigeon ever sneezes on my keyboard I will formally retire.
Maya: Also leaving this here: https://giphy.com/gifs/pigeon-hat-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA (for design inspo) :laughing: 
Aisha: Thanks everyone — this is peak watercooler. If Facilities says no hat, we start a petition.
Tom: Petition draft: "In support of dignified headwear for balcony fauna." Who's in?
Jun: Count me in. For the ficus.
Kerry: In. For the sash.
Leon: I'll sign after I stop laughing.
Ops Bot: Poll closed. Final results: :one: 3, :two: 2, :three: 1, :four: 1. Outcome: Tiny hat + sign wins.
Aisha: Victory for horticultural safety. Meeting adjourned. :raised_hands:
